outcome: Intercellular spaces in spinous cell layer
Proliferating cell nuclear antigen immunoreactive expression
cohort: The study included 15 adult Egyptian women, divided into three groups: nulligravidas, primigravidas, and multigravidas.
finding: Repeated abdominal skin stretching due to pregnancy induced significant histological and ultrastructural changes compared to single stretching or nulligravida controls, including increased keratinocyte thickness, wider intercellular spaces, deeper dermal papillae, disorganized collagen, decreased elastic fibers, and increased myofibroblast activity.
cross-section timing: Biopsies were taken from nulligravidas (control) and from primigravida and multigravida women during cesarean deliveries.
